ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of the Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 binds successors and assigns but does not regulate assignment, so HDI could transfer this development and hosting engagement, and access to our data and customer-facing site, to a competitor. We have added one concise sentence pair confirming our affiliate/successor carve-out and conditioning HDI's assignment on our prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld and never to a competitor; we can instead accept the mutual successor-assignment-on-written-notice fallback if preferred.
proposal.summary: Insert a concise assignment provision: our affiliate/successor carve-out and HDI assignment only with our consent, not unreasonably withheld, never to a competitor.
